Consolidated Account Statement

How to download the capital gains statement

Investors can request a consolidated account statement through the AMC website or the registrar and transfer agent portal, and receive it by email. The statement is also available in the investors account dashboard under the reports section.

Tax related documents and reporting

Capital gains statements help investors compute tax liability on mutual fund redemptions and switches for the relevant assessment year, and are needed for filing income tax returns.
